## Goal

## The big idea

What the parts of a computer do (CPU, RAM, storage, network port) and why they matter for a server.

## Outline

- Options: old PC or laptop, mini PC, Raspberry Pi
- The reference machine this book assumes
- Storage basics: SSD for the system, a bigger drive for media
- Wired vs Wi-Fi, and why the server should be wired
- Power, noise, heat and where to put it
